standard: Visible refinement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

front.note: Rounded flower clusters and broader ovate leaves improve the original angular fans while retaining the source planting arrangement.

rear.note: The reverse view keeps the individual branching stems and layered foliage beneath the dense flower heads.

detail.note: Full-size detail shows rounded cupped florets and retained raised leaf midribs; the upright bare flower stalks remain a stylized source limitation.

underside.note: The underside preserves connected stems, layered leaves and the original grounded footprint.

clay.note: The clay view confirms denser rounded petal contours and shaped leaves without replacing the original cluster positions.

front.note: The circular rug now reads as interlaced textile rows instead of smooth plastic rings.

rear.note: The reverse angle shows coherent concentric weaving and a thin continuous outer edge.

detail.note: Full-size detail shows overlapping strand relief across the original concentric pattern; the braid remains a bounded stylized weave.

underside.note: The original closed backing supports the thin woven face and preserves the circular footprint.

clay.note: The clay view confirms modeled braided relief across the rug while retaining its original low thickness.

front.note: The kettle lid and bowl are visibly smoother, but the original vent plate remains partly buried in the domed lid.

rear.note: Rear bowl, handle, legs and wheels remain coherent; the vent needs a final surface contact correction.

detail.note: Full-size detail confirms the improved dome and the half-visible vent damper; seat the existing plate and dark vent marks on the actual lid surface.

underside.note: The hollow shell construction and supported ash catcher are retained beneath the smoother bowl.

clay.note: The clay view confirms improved spun profiles; preserve them while correcting the inherited vent placement.

front.note: A long spacebar and separated modifier keys make the keyboard layout clearer, and the mouse has a shaped shell with visible controls.

rear.note: The reverse view preserves the keyboard footprint and the mouse's rounded palm shape.

detail.note: Full-size detail confirms the real long spacebar and distinct lower-row modifiers; blank key legends remain an explicit catalog-scale simplification.

underside.note: Both devices retain closed supported undersides and their original relative placement.

clay.note: The clay view confirms differentiated key widths and the smooth mouse shell without changing the original device envelopes.

front.note: The house-shaped frame and fitted bedding retain their original proportions with the pillow piping now seated.

rear.note: The reverse view preserves the roof beams, posts and supported bed platform.

detail.note: Full-size detail shows continuous pillow piping following the cover instead of hovering above it; the pale default palette keeps contrast intentionally quiet.

underside.note: The original closed bed base and frame remain coherent beneath the corrected bedding.

clay.note: The clay view confirms the pillow's fitted trim and unchanged mattress, quilt and house frame.

front.note: The tabletop and flared pedestal now have smooth circular outlines and a clear supported connection.

rear.note: The rear view preserves the original child-size proportions and round foot.

detail.note: Full-size detail confirms the continuous turned profiles and the pedestal seated beneath the top.

underside.note: The underside shows the top supported by the widened pedestal contact and a closed round base.

clay.note: The clay view removes the obvious coarse radial facets while retaining the original turned design.

front.note: The wrapped back shell is smoother, but the seat edge and purple welt remain visibly wavy and puckered.

rear.note: The rear shell contour is improved and the metal feet remain attached.

detail.note: Full-size detail shows the welt seated on an unevenly pinched cover; restore a restrained rounded-rectangle cushion crown and use the original seam path.

underside.note: The supported seat pan and original legs remain intact beneath the revised shell.

clay.note: The clay view confirms the smoother back but still shows exaggerated seat-edge puckering that needs a narrow cushion correction.

front.note: The mug retains its real cavity and now has a smoother continuous D handle.

rear.note: The reverse view shows the rounded handle transitions attached at both original ceramic mounting points.

detail.note: Full-size detail confirms softened handle bends and solid attachments; the subtle glazed surface remains faithful to the existing material.

underside.note: The original recessed foot and closed mug base remain intact beneath the improved handle.

clay.note: The clay view confirms a recognizable hollow mug and a continuous rounded handle within the original silhouette.
